verdict.rationale: cubic is a SaaS code-review platform with public APIs, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents no isolated sandbox that keeps testing away from production data. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: auto-approval "shadow mode" is a dry-run preview inside live repos, not sandbox isolation, and the API "Try it" playground sends authenticated requests to the real API with no documented test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
